## Problem and resulting change

Describe the concrete problem, final behavior, and linked issue. Keep scope focused.

## Evidence

List commands actually run and their outcomes. Mark untested behavior NOT TESTED. Link source/claim IDs for factual changes.

## Public data check

- [ ] No secrets, personal details, raw interviews, contracts, or unlicensed external files.
- [ ] Claims are classified and traceable; unsupported numbers are not stated as facts.
- [ ] Internal links and repository checks pass; original user work is preserved.

## Remaining risks

Identify unresolved limitations and follow-up issues. Review approval is optional; Write collaborators can merge without approval.
